title: Listeners of the opening track
statementMd:
List listeners who played a track number 1 on any album. Show distinct names.

Expected columns: `name`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT l.name FROM listeners l JOIN plays p ON p.listener_id = l.id JOIN tracks t ON t.id = p.track_id WHERE t.track_no = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
